clue.text: Pirate gets second prize

definitions.meaning: Long John ... is the pirate of Stevenson's Treasure Island
the medal for coming second, after gold

explanation.definitionFit: Long John Silver is a famous fictional buccaneer, and second place earns the silver medal.

clue.text: Make no comment on stream nearly left to dry up

parts.note: sh is the call for silence, a request to say nothing

indicators.note: nearly says the word for stream stops short of its last letter

parts.note: a river is a stream

explanation.surface: Someone keeps quiet while a stream nearly runs dry.
explanation.definitionFit: To wither is to dry up and wrinkle, losing moisture and shrinking.

clue.text: Bearing much from terrorist

definitions.meaning: heavily loaded, carrying a great deal
the surname of the al-Qaeda leader Osama bin ..., 'from' because bin means son of

explanation.definitionFit: Laden means heavily loaded, and it is also the family name of a notorious terrorist.

clue.text: Odd boy accepting one-dollar entry

indicators.note: accepting means the boy's name takes another piece into itself

parts.note: Eric is a boy's name
C is a hundred, and a hundred cents make one dollar, so C CENT is the entry

explanation.surface: A strange lad pays a dollar to get in.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone eccentric is odd or unconventional in behaviour.

clue.text: A new Irish president's first subject to inflation

indicators.note: new means the letters of the word Irish are made into a fresh arrangement
first says only the opening letter of president's is used

explanation.surface: A newly elected Irish head of state is caught up in rising prices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns IRISH into IRSHI. 'subject to inflation' sounds like economics, but an airship is literally inflated with gas.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirigible balloon is filled with gas, so it is literally something blown up.

clue.text: A circle with some power is soothing

parts.note: a circle is an O, so 'a circle' is AN O
a dyne is a unit of force, so a quantity of power

explanation.surface: A ring with a little strength in it calms things down.
explanation.definitionFit: An anodyne is a painkiller, so as an adjective it means soothing or inoffensive.

clue.text: Put off sick person getting up

indicators.note: in a down clue, getting up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a leper is a person with leprosy

explanation.surface: An ill man rising from bed proves off-putting.
explanation.definitionFit: To repel is to drive back or disgust, putting someone off.

clue.text: Audible breeze is threatening things in the family

indicators.note: audible says the next word is to be taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: air is a light breeze
something that looms is threatening

explanation.surface: A breeze you can hear seems menacing to the household.
explanation.definitionFit: Heirlooms are possessions handed down through generations of a family.

clue.text: See 8
Nearly enough for two chess sets, the 10 of 26 if 1 across

definitions.text: Nearly enough for two chess sets
definitions.meaning: two chess sets hold 32 men, so two short of that
the price of blood if silver: Judas was paid that many silver coins to betray Jesus

explanation.walkthrough: 10 is PRICE, 26 BLOOD and 1 across SILVER: the blood money Judas received.
explanation.definitionFit: Judas's blood money was paid in silver coins, so the price of blood in silver was that number of coins.

clue.text: Salad vegetable for choir with acid effect

indicators.note: effect, as in to effect a change, says the letters of choir and acid are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: A singer's salad dressing has an acidic effect on the choir.
explanation.definitionFit: Radicchio is a bitter red chicory eaten raw in salads.

clue.text: How much food goes on top of plate?

indicators.note: top of says only the first letter of plate is taken

parts.note: rice is a staple food

explanation.surface: A diner asks the cost of the food heaped on a plate.
explanation.definitionFit: The price of a thing is the answer to asking how much it costs.

clue.text: Toxic element in ravening wolves

indicators.note: in says the answer is sitting inside the following words

explanation.surface: Wild hungry wolves carry poison in their bite.
explanation.definitionFit: Venin is a toxic substance found in snake venom.

clue.text: King's depressed shade

parts.note: belonging to a king is royal
to feel blue is to be depressed

explanation.surface: A monarch is in a gloomy mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Royal blue is a deep bright shade of blue.

clue.text: Presumption OK in this hall?

definitions.meaning: taking a ... is acting with presumption
... Hall is a place where anyone may do as they like

explanation.definitionFit: A liberty is an act of presumption, and Liberty Hall is the proverbial place where anything goes.

clue.text: Second helping of Indian food with American port

parts.note: a balti is a curry dish cooked in a metal pan, popular in Britain
asking for more is asking for a second helping

explanation.surface: A diner goes back for seconds of curry alongside an American.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue gives the second helping first; the pieces join with the curry first.
explanation.definitionFit: Baltimore is a major seaport city in Maryland, USA.

clue.text: Get along mostly with spectroscopic device

indicators.note: mostly says the phrase loses a little, here its outer letters, leaving most of it

explanation.surface: Someone muddles through with a piece of lab kit.
explanation.definitionFit: An etalon is an interferometer of two parallel mirrors used in spectroscopy.

clue.text: Day off during which space station's key to board

indicators.note: during which places the following pieces inside the rearranged letters
off says the letters of day are jumbled

parts.note: Mir was the Soviet and Russian space station
Alt is a key on a computer keyboard

explanation.surface: On a day off, the space station's key to the boardroom goes missing.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal 'off' makes ADY. Admiralty here means the naval governing board, not the sea power itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The Admiralty Board was the body that governed the British Royal Navy.

clue.text: Girl who would have a good start around Santiago de Compostela

indicators.note: the girl's name would become the region if given a G at its start, so that letter is removed

parts.note: Galicia is the Spanish region whose capital is Santiago de Compostela

explanation.surface: A girl with good beginnings lives near the pilgrim city in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Alicia is a female first name, a Spanish form related to Alice, so it fits a girl.

clue.text: One of three in song heard who has come

indicators.note: heard says the phrase is taken by its sound

parts.note: a rival, the third party in the love triangle songs dwell on

explanation.surface: A singer hears that one of a trio has turned up.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrival is a person who has just come.

clue.text: Diffusion of liquid is consequent upon the world blowing its top

indicators.note: consequent upon means following after, so the next piece is placed after
blowing its top says the word for the world loses its first letter

parts.note: the cosmos is the world or universe
taken as written

explanation.surface: Liquid spreads as a result of the world flying into a rage.
explanation.definitionFit: Osmosis is the diffusion of a solvent through a membrane.

clue.text: Oxygen and hydrogen in close to heaven?

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

indicators.note: in places one piece within another

parts.note: nigh means near or close to
H is the chemical symbol for hydrogen

explanation.surface: Two gases are close to the skies.
explanation.definitionFit: On high means in the heavens, up above.

clue.text: Singer and painter second to 1 across

parts.note: the answer to 1 across is the metal argent names in heraldry

explanation.surface: A singer and an artist come second to a pirate.
explanation.definitionFit: John Singer Sargent was an American portrait painter, so Singer is his middle name.

clue.text: Holding one's own and the horses?

definitions.meaning: the building where horses are kept, or the horses kept there

explanation.definitionFit: Stable means steady and firm, and a stable houses horses.

clue.text: Skipper, formerly Roman Catholic, embraced by Harriet who's lapsed

indicators.note: embraced by puts the earlier piece inside the following one
lapsed means fallen away from its proper state, so the letters of Harriet are rearranged

explanation.surface: A former Catholic captain is hugged by Harriet, who has stopped attending church.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal 'who's lapsed' makes TRIERAH; 'Skipper, formerly' points to an ancient Greek trireme captain, not a modern skipper.
explanation.definitionFit: A trierarch commanded a trireme in ancient Greece, a ship's captain of former times.

clue.text: Gas attack being made audibly

indicators.note: audibly says the phrase is taken by sound

parts.note: a raid on something is an attack being made on it

explanation.surface: A gas attack is launched with a lot of noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Radon is a radioactive noble gas.

clue.text: Right about dog?

parts.note: over means about, as in a quarrel over money

explanation.surface: Correct, that is about a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: Rover is a traditional name for a pet dog, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Records of some village outside US city

indicators.note: outside puts the first piece round the second
some says only part of the word village is used

parts.note: NY is New York

explanation.surface: Records of a village somewhere outside an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: Vinyl stands for gramophone records, which are pressed from that plastic.

clue.text: Pedigree for fully paid 10 of 16, according to Kipling

definitions.meaning: ancestry or breeding, as in a horse's lineage

definitions.text: fully paid 10 of 16, according to Kipling
definitions.meaning: Kipling wrote 'If ... be the price of admiralty, Lord God, we ha' paid in full!'

explanation.definitionFit: Blood means lineage or descent, and Kipling's Song of the English names it as the price of admiralty.

clue.text: Cable holds monster that needs watching

indicators.note: holds says the first piece has the second inside it

parts.note: Vince Cable is a British Liberal Democrat politician
the Gila monster is a venomous lizard

explanation.surface: A cable contains something monstrous that has to be kept an eye on.
explanation.definitionFit: Vigilance is keeping careful watch.

clue.text: Bird first in line to show this 27 the 10 of 13

annotationWithheld.why: Bird first in line to show this 27 the 10 of 13 (7): TERN accounts for four letters of ETERNAL, but no parse of the remaining E, A, L from 'first in line to show this' was found
annotationWithheld.clue: Bird first in line to show this 27 the 10 of 13

clue.text: Little hole for (say) 8, say

indicators.note: the second say marks a sound-alike

parts.note: eight said aloud is ait, a little river island or islet

explanation.surface: A small hole made for an island.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyelet is a small hole for a lace or cord.
